title: Sort Of Works
text: Sort Of Works. After watching a lot of commercials I decided I needed one of these. I used it in my studio for cleaning up my drawing table. Had a fair amount of issues with it getting clogged up. It has a lot of suction and it grabs big and small things and you have to keep picking stuff of the bristles. I think it would be fine for use in kitchen drawers, but not so much where there is a combination of fine debris mixed with larger bits. The larger bits present a problem.
